create_gradslam_dataset: create a GradSLAMDataset instance from a config dict to load color, depth, and pose data
create_eqa_dataset: create an EQADataset instance from a config dict and sequence folder to load EQA data
build_intrinsics_matrix: build a 3x3 camera intrinsics matrix from fx, fy, cx, cy values using as_intrinsics_matrix
extract_intrinsics_from_matrix: extract fx, fy, cx, cy scalars from a camera intrinsics matrix using from_intrinsics_matrix
read_depth_from_exr: read depth buffer data from an EXR image file using readEXR_onlydepth
